# 04 — Expected_utility

One chapter, one product folder. `chapter.json` is the identity and publication source; `source/approved.md` is the selected prose.

Build all artifacts: `python scripts/build_products.py --chapter expected-utility`. Build the public archive: `python scripts/build_site.py`.

`artwork/` holds source, scene crops and format exports; `book/` the A5 proof; `video/` rendered cuts and caption tracks; `social/` the channel packs; `web/` the rendered page; `docs/` evidence and limitations; `previews/` the contact sheets and screenshots.

No narration is generated. Existing artwork is an interpretation. Future print masters require printer specifications and source art at sufficient resolution.
